Code actions: the fix a finding carries, the comments that suppress it,
and every safe fix at once.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
lint:
  rules:
    unformatted: info
-- lib/obj/a.c --
void f()
{
    string s;

    s = "one" "two";
    s == "x" "y";
}
-- script --
initialize lib
open lib/obj/a.c
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c

# On the line of the first finding: its fix, preferred because it is
# safe, and the two comments.
actions lib/obj/a.c 4:15-4:15
# Asked for one kind, the server answers with that kind.
actions lib/obj/a.c 0:0-7:0 source.fixAll
apply 0
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c

# What is left has no fix: it can be suppressed, for the line or the file.
actions lib/obj/a.c 5:6-5:8 quickfix
apply 0
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
# A comment that is about the line already takes the next rule too.
replace lib/obj/a.c "void f()\n{\n    string s;\n\n    /* dgdtools-ignore lint/sscanf-format */\n    s == \"x\" \"y\";\n}\n"
actions lib/obj/a.c 5:6-5:6 quickfix
apply 0
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
# For the file: a range from its first line.
actions lib/obj/a.c 5:13-5:13 quickfix
apply 2
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c

shutdown
exit
